description: Source-backed forward order-to-cash flow: snapdeal_oms transaction_type='forward' captures order and status; invoice/shipment/delivery milestones lead to snapdeal_settlement COD/NCOD Vendor Invoice rows; snapdeal_commission records fee invoice; snapdeal_non_order records TDS; snapdeal_payments closes payout by UTR.
entry_condition: snapdeal_oms.transaction_type = 'forward' with current_order_state initially In Transit/Shipped/Delivered
exit_condition: payment transferred through snapdeal_payments.utr_no_ matching snapdeal_settlement.settlement_id
name: Snapdeal Forward Order Flow

description: Marketplace-internal reconciliation process across OMS, settlement, payments, commission, non_order TDS, and sales_return; reconciliation profiles define expected/actual sides rather than generic lifecycle steps.
entry_condition: source tables have active rows for the relevant reconciliation unit
exit_condition: records are matched, classified as timing/data gaps, or marked review-required when source population/runtime scope is incomplete
name: Snapdeal marketplace-internal reconciliation

description: Source-backed reverse/return flow: snapdeal_oms transaction_type='reverse' and current_order_state Return Initiated/Accepted/Delivered; settlement reversal uses transaction_type='reverse' and type values such as COD Return to Vendor or COD RTS to Vendor; sales_return is a provisioned credit-note table but empty in current data; commission reversals are optional.
entry_condition: buyer return creates snapdeal_oms.transaction_type = 'reverse' / current_order_state = 'Return Initiated'
exit_condition: reverse settlement is deducted in settlement/payment batch, with optional commission reversal and future sales_return credit note
name: Snapdeal Reverse / Return Flow
